ns2:course.label: Nuclear Materials
ns2:course.description: Metallurgical principles applied to materials problems in nuclear engineering; topics in production of uranium, corrosion, radiation damage, fuel element fabrication, and fuel reprocessing. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: NPRE 430.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: NPRE 430.
